Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (July 17, 2025) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Tender, Doc5006610301, Contract Number 23TW-CTS-17CWD Description: Supply and installation of twin sanitary forcemains, a new valve chamber, maintenance holes, and modifications to pumping stations at three (3) different Sewage Pumping Stations in the City of Toronto. Recommended Supplier: Drainstar Contracting Ltd. Contract Award Value: $4,731,006 net of all applicable taxes and charges $5,346,037 including HST and all applicable charges $4,814,272 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on date of award and end on December 31, 2027.
